_doc: Route side (methodology 3.9.3, H3). Per layout: the leg on which the route decision happens (0 = Start -> POI, 1 = POI -> End) and gate segments in world x/z metres. An episode's route side is the side of the first gate its body trajectory crosses on that leg. In both layouts the start -> POI leg has to pass the central obstacle either north (+z) or south (-z); each gate runs along x = 0 from inside the obstacle to the outer wall on one side.
